market: Dallas, Tarrant, Collin and Denton counties, Texas

companies.name: BakerTriangle
companies.segment: Drywall, acoustical and exterior specialty construction

sources.name: Dallas City Council agendas and minutes
sources.caution: An agenda proposal is not an approved award. Find the decision and named executing contractor.

sources.name: Fort Worth procurement and bids
sources.caution: Bid solicitations are discovery hints, not awards. Bonfire may require separate access.

sources.name: Fort Worth City Secretary public documents
sources.caution: Check event dates and completion status; newly indexed records may describe old projects.

sources.name: TxDOT statewide letting and awards
sources.geography: Texas; filter Dallas and Fort Worth districts
sources.caution: Distinguish letting schedules, bid tabs, apparent low bidders and final award decisions.

sources.name: SAM.gov contract opportunities
sources.geography: United States; filter place of performance
sources.caution: API key and quotas apply. Most opportunity notices are not completed awards.

sources.name: USAspending federal award data
sources.geography: United States; filter place of performance
sources.caution: Transactions may be modifications or obligations on an existing award. Use award identity and action dates.

sources.name: Construction Dive
sources.caution: Corroborate company identity and event dates with primary sources.

sources.name: Engineering News-Record
sources.caution: Some articles require a subscription. Keep the reference and seek accessible primary corroboration.

sources.name: Dallas Innovates
sources.caution: Editorial and sponsored/company-supplied material must retain their different provenance.

sources.name: Business Wire
sources.caution: Syndicated copies of one announcement are one source lineage, not independent corroboration.

sources.name: Dallas Regional Chamber
sources.caution: Identify the contractor/employer; the company opening a building may not employ the construction crew.

sources.name: Fort Worth Economic Development Partnership
sources.caution: Planned investment does not establish an award, mobilization or apparel requirement.

platforms.name: LinkedIn
platforms.notes: Search public indexed company/posts/jobs pages. General automated profile/feed scraping is not the integration. Approved API products have permissions and use-case restrictions.

platforms.name: Instagram
platforms.notes: Official API eligibility and permissions need account-specific verification. Indexed public posts are partial coverage; do not claim access to all posts or Stories.

platforms.name: X
platforms.notes: Public indexed search initially. Official API requires developer credentials and a separately capped budget. Preserve original twitter.com URLs and normalize account identity to X.

platforms.name: Indeed
platforms.notes: Discover indexed employer/job pages, then corroborate vacancies on the employer's linked careers/ATS site. Employer pages can be unclaimed. Never count advertised jobs as workers.

platforms.name: Facebook
platforms.notes: Prefer pages linked from the official company website. API access to Page content depends on permissions; indexed coverage is incomplete.

platforms.name: YouTube
platforms.notes: Company channels and project announcements may aid research. Upload date is not necessarily the project date. No inference of headcount from people in a video.

platforms.name: TikTok
platforms.notes: Retain official company links when present. No assumption of general commercial research API access.
